name: wj-skills
description: William Jin's agent skills: fresh-context design review, tutorials, task sprints, variations, humanizer, ICM architect, Jira, handoff, UI design

plugins.name: tutor
plugins.description: Audience-aware tutorials and Q&A for any codebase: /tutor:init, /tutor:write, /tutor:ask

plugins.name: goldfish
plugins.description: Fresh-context review of a design doc or plan: critic and reader with no chat history, a zoom-out pass, claims checked against the code (/goldfish:review)

plugins.name: task-sprint
plugins.description: Sequential task execution from dated .task-sprint/ checklist files

plugins.name: variations
plugins.description: HITL batches of diverse numbered variations for copy, offers, UI flows, and other taste-heavy decisions (default 10)

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Write and rewrite human-facing text so it reads like the writer: a words pass and a structure pass (blader/humanizer + no-ai-slop + humanizer-stack)

plugins.name: icm-architect
plugins.description: Turn a workflow, idea, or folder into an ICM workspace one agent can walk (vendored from RinDig/icm-architect)

plugins.name: jira
plugins.description: Jira work items through the official Atlassian CLI (acli): read, search, comment, transition, with writes behind approval

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Write a session handoff beside the design docs before /clear; /handoff:resume loads it and the files to reread

plugins.name: stagefilm
plugins.description: Film the real app's motion (SwiftUI or web stories), read it frame by frame, fix it to the stageshow rules: one source of truth, no faux UI

plugins.name: app-design
plugins.description: Native-quality mobile screens to a checkable bar: HIG fidelity, anti-slop counts, navigation and motion laws, a full-motion simulator loop. Vendored from Appllama (design skill only), plus a SwiftUI map
